description: This file defines the TerminationReason entity class for the OrangeHRM project. It maps to the database table 'ohrm_emp_termination_reason' and includes properties for 'id' and 'name' with their respective getters and setters, representing reasons for employee termination within the HR system.

classes.name: TerminationReason
classes.description: Entity class representing a termination reason with properties for 'id' and 'name' and corresponding getter/setter methods.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the termination reason.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the termination reason.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the termination reason.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the termination reason.
